what: PXDesign GPU reference: seconds per design on one H200, split per pipeline stage

protocol.reps: rep 0 discarded as cold (two CUDA extensions JIT-compile on first use), median over the warm reps
protocol.batch: batch is --N_sample, the number of backbones from one diffusion call; a cell is comparable only against a cell with the same target length AND the same N_sample
protocol.presets: extended = AF2-IG + Protenix base filter; preview = AF2-IG only. Recorded separately, never pooled
protocol.stage_split: leaf stages partition the run; gen_total and eval_total are umbrellas over leaves and are never summed into the split
protocol.kernel_paths: counted, not inferred: DS4Sci_EvoformerAttention call count per run
protocol.exclusivity: every compute app on the card is recorded before and after each cell

how_to_read.the_bar: tt_target_s_4x_device is the org's 4x rule applied to the device-busy portion. tt_target_s_4x_wall is the same rule on wall clock and is only meaningful if both arms' host CPUs are comparable, because most of a PXDesign run is host work the TT port inherits unchanged.
how_to_read.device_s: wall x mean GPU utilisation over the stage's own sampling window
how_to_read.batch: always compare against a cell with the same target_residues AND the same batch_n_sample

target_manifest.note: each rung is its own single-chain CIF cut from 1DP0 chain A around one fixed epitope and renumbered 1..N, because PXDesign leaves the entity sequence uncropped when the yaml uses target.chains.<id>.crop
